# Quran Universe

> Read all 114 surahs of the Quran in Arabic with English translation, transliteration, word-by-word meaning and Tafsir Ibn Kathir, plus a simple card that explains every verse.

Quran Universe is written for Muslims who want to understand what they recite and for non-Muslims exploring Islam. Each verse page has the Arabic text, the Sahih International English translation, transliteration, word-by-word meaning, a plain-English card (historical setting, modern relevance, one practical step) and the full Tafsir Ibn Kathir.

Verse URLs follow https://quranuniverse.app/surah/<surah-slug>/<verse-number>, for example https://quranuniverse.app/surah/al-baqarah/255 for Ayat al-Kursi (2:255).

## Guides

- [Al-Andalus: The History of Muslim Spain (711–1492)](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/al-andalus-muslim-spain): Al-Andalus was Muslim-ruled Iberia from 711 to 1492. Learn its history, from the Caliphate of Córdoba to the fall of Granada, and the convivencia debate.
- [Alhamdulillah Meaning: Praise and Gratitude in Islam](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/alhamdulillah-meaning): Alhamdulillah means "all praise is for God." Learn its Arabic, its place in Surah al-Fatihah (1:2), why Muslims say it after sneezing, and how to reply to it.
- [Angels in Islam: Who They Are, Their Names and Roles](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/angels-in-islam): Angels in Islam are beings created from light who always obey God. Learn their names and roles, from Jibril and Mikail to the Kiraman Katibin.
- [Astaghfirullah Meaning: Seeking Forgiveness in Islam](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/astaghfirullah-meaning): Astaghfirullah means "I seek forgiveness from God." Learn its Arabic, Quran 71:10-12, the Sayyid al-Istighfar dua, istighfar benefits and when Muslims say it.
- [Ayatul Kursi Meaning, Transliteration and Benefits Explained](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/ayatul-kursi): Ayatul Kursi is verse 255 of Surah al-Baqarah. Read its English transliteration, translation, phrase-by-phrase meaning, and authentic benefits of reciting it.
- [Bismillah Meaning: "In the Name of God, the Most Merciful"](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/bismillah-meaning): Bismillah means "in the name of God." Learn the basmala word by word, ar-Rahman vs ar-Raheem, why Surah at-Tawbah lacks it, and why Muslims say it before meals.
- [What Does the Quran Say About Christians and Jews? A Clear Guide](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/christians-and-jews-in-the-quran): What does the Quran say about Christians and Jews? Learn who the People of the Book are, the verses of praise and critique, and how Muslims should treat them.
- [Daily Duas: Dua for Travel, Breaking Fast, Eating and Sleep](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/daily-duas): Daily duas every Muslim should know, from waking to sleep: the dua for travel, breaking fast, eating, leaving home and more, with translation and hadith source.
- [Does God Exist? Rational Arguments from an Islamic Perspective](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/does-god-exist): Does God exist? The arguments philosophers debate, from al-Ghazali's kalam and Ibn Sina's contingency proof to fine-tuning, with the strongest objections.
- [Does God Forgive All Sins? Tawbah and the Dua for Forgiveness](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/does-god-forgive-all-sins): Does God forgive all sins? Yes: Quran 39:53 says Allah forgives all sins for those who repent. Learn the steps of tawbah and the best duas for forgiveness.
- [Dogs in Islam: Can Muslims Have Dogs, and Do Muslims Hate Dogs?](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/dogs-in-islam): Do Muslims hate dogs? No. Islam forbids cruelty to dogs, and a man was forgiven for giving one water. See the purity rulings, permitted dogs and key views.
- [Dreams in Islam: Types, Meaning and Islamic Dream Interpretation](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/dreams-in-islam): Islamic dream interpretation starts with three types of dreams: from God, from Satan and from the mind. What to do after each, and why dictionaries mislead.
- [Dua for Anxiety and Stress: Quran Verses and Prophetic Duas](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/dua-for-anxiety-and-stress): The top dua for stress and anxiety is the Prophet's prayer against worry and grief (Sahih al-Bukhari 6369). Read it with Quran verses and practical steps.
- [The Evil Eye in Islam: Is It Real and How to Protect Yourself](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/evil-eye-in-islam): The evil eye in Islam is real, the Prophet said, but harms only by God's will. Learn the authentic duas for protection, ruqyah and why amulets are rejected.
- [What Is Fitrah? Human Nature and Innate Belief in God](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/fitrah-human-nature-in-islam): Fitrah is the natural disposition God created in every human, inclining them to recognize Him. Learn the fitrah meaning, Quran 30:30, the hadith and science.
- [Five Pillars of Islam Explained in Order, With Quran Verses](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/five-pillars-of-islam): The five pillars of Islam are shahada, salah, zakat, sawm and hajj. Learn what each one means, the order they come in and where each appears in the Quran.
- [4 Quls in English With Meaning, Benefits and Correct Order](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/four-quls): The 4 Quls are Surahs al-Kafirun, al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq and an-Nas. Read each in English with transliteration, meaning, benefits and when to recite them.
- [How Many Surahs in the Quran? Surahs, Verses, Juz and Words](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/how-many-surahs-and-verses-in-the-quran): How many surahs in the Quran? There are 114 surahs and 6,236 verses in 30 juz. See why verse counts differ, the longest and shortest surahs and the full list.
- [How to Convert to Islam: A Simple Step-by-Step Guide](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/how-to-convert-to-islam): How to convert to Islam: sincerely believe, then say the shahada. No fee, ceremony or witnesses required. What to do next, and where new Muslims find support.
- [How to Get Closer to God: Practical Steps from the Quran](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/how-to-get-closer-to-god): How to get closer to God in Islam: pray on time, remember Him often, read the Quran with reflection, pray at night, make dua and serve others. A 7-day plan.
- [99 Names of Allah With Meaning: How to Learn and Memorize Them](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/how-to-learn-99-names-of-allah): The 99 Names of Allah with meaning, Arabic and transliteration in order, plus a 10-week plan and proven memory techniques to learn and memorize all of them.
- [How to Perform Wudu Step by Step (With Dua After Wudu)](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/how-to-perform-wudu): How to perform wudu: wash the hands, mouth, nose, face and arms, wipe the head, then wash the feet. Steps, dua after wudu, what breaks wudu and tayammum.
- [How to Pray Salah Step by Step, With Words and Translation](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/how-to-pray-salah): How to pray salah step by step: what to do and say in each position, in Arabic, transliteration and English, with rakat counts and madhhab differences.
- [How to Read the Quran for Beginners in Arabic and English](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/how-to-read-the-quran): How to read the Quran as a beginner, in Arabic or in English. Where to start, how to use a translation and tafsir, basic etiquette and simple tajweed tips.
- [Inshallah Meaning: What It Means and When to Say It](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/inshallah-meaning): Inshallah means "if God wills." Learn its Arabic spelling, the Quran verse that teaches it (18:23-24), when Muslims say it and how to reply to it.
- [Is Allah the Same God Christians and Jews Worship?](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/is-allah-the-same-god): Is Allah the same God? Islam teaches that Allah is the God of Abraham worshipped by Jews and Christians, understood differently. See Quran 29:46.
- [Is Islam a Religion of Peace? What the Quran and History Say](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/is-islam-a-religion-of-peace): Is Islam a religion of peace? The Quran values peace and permits only limited defensive war. The "sword verse" in context, the history, and Pew and Gallup data.
- [Is Jesus God? What Islam Teaches About Jesus' Nature](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/is-jesus-god-islamic-view): Is Jesus God? Islam teaches that Jesus is the Messiah and a beloved prophet, but not God. See the Quran's verses, the Bible texts Christians cite, and Nicaea.
- [Is Music Haram in Islam? The Scholarly Views Explained](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/is-music-haram): Is it haram to listen to music? Muslim scholars disagree. See the evidence for each view, from Ibn Taymiyyah to Ibn Hazm and al-Ghazali, plus nasheeds.
- [Islam vs Christianity: Key Similarities and Differences](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/islam-vs-christianity): Islam vs Christianity compared: both worship the God of Abraham and honor Jesus, but differ on the Trinity, the cross and scripture. A fair, sourced comparison.
- [Islamic Golden Age: Science, Medicine and Its Lasting Legacy](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/islamic-golden-age): The Islamic Golden Age (c. 750–1258) saw scholars in Baghdad, Cairo and Córdoba advance algebra, optics and medicine. Key figures, sources and debates.
- [Istikhara Prayer: How to Pray It, the Dua and What to Expect](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/istikhara-prayer): Istikhara is a two-rakat prayer and dua asking God to choose what is best. Learn how to pray salat al-istikhara, the dua in English, and what signs to expect.
- [Jannah in Islam: Meaning, Levels, Gates and What Paradise Is Like](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/jannah-in-islam): Jannah meaning in Islam: the Garden of Paradise promised to believers. Learn what the Quran says it is like, its 100 levels, al-Firdaus and its 8 gates.
- [Jesus in the Quran - Who Is Isa and What Does the Quran Say?](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/jesus-in-the-quran): Jesus in the Quran is Isa, son of Mary, a great prophet born of a virgin. See what the Quran says about his birth, miracles, the crucifixion and his return.
- [Surah Al Baqarah Last Two Ayat, Meaning and Benefits](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/last-two-verses-of-surah-al-baqarah): The last two ayat of Surah al-Baqarah, verses 285 and 286, suffice whoever recites them at night. Read their translation, transliteration, meaning and benefits.
- [Laylatul Qadr, the Night of Power, Meaning, Dua and Signs](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/laylatul-qadr): Laylatul Qadr is the Night of Power, better than a thousand months. Learn when it falls, its signs, the authentic dua, what to do, and Surah al-Qadr in English.
- [Mary in the Quran and Maryam in Islam, Her Story Explained](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/mary-in-the-quran): Mary in the Quran is honored above the women of the worlds. Read the story of Maryam in Islam, the virgin birth of Jesus, and why a surah is named after her.
- [Mashallah Meaning: When to Say It, and Mashallah vs Tabarakallah](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/mashallah-meaning): Mashallah means "what God has willed." Learn its Arabic, its origin in Quran 18:39, its link to the evil eye, mashallah vs inshallah, and tabarakallah.
- [What Is the Meaning of Life? The Islamic Answer Explained](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/meaning-of-life-in-islam): What is the meaning of life? In Islam, the purpose of life is to know and worship God, to be tested through good deeds, and to care for the earth as a steward.
- [Meccan and Medinan Surahs Explained, With the Makki Surah List](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/meccan-and-medinan-surahs): What are Meccan and Medinan surahs? Learn the difference between Makki and Madani surahs, how scholars classify them, the full list and the revelation order.
- [Muslim vs Islam - What Is the Difference Between the Two Words?](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/muslim-vs-islam): Muslim vs Islam explained simply. Islam is the religion and a Muslim is a person who follows it. Learn what each word means and when to say Islamic instead.
- [What Are the 99 Names of Allah? Quran, Hadith and the Famous List](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/origin-of-the-99-names-of-allah): What are the 99 names of Allah and where do they come from? The hadith on the number, the Tirmidhi list and its grading, the Quran and other scholarly lists.
- [How Many Wives Can a Muslim Have? Polygamy in Islam Explained](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/polygamy-in-islam): How many wives can a Muslim have? Islam permits up to four, only with justice between them (Quran 4:3). Most Muslims are monogamous. The conditions and laws.
- [Who Was the Prophet Muhammad? A Short Biography and Timeline](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/prophet-muhammad-biography): Prophet Muhammad (c. 570–632) was born in Makkah, received the Quran from 610 and died in Medina. A clear biography with a dated timeline and sources.
- [Prophets in the Quran - List of All 25 Named Prophets](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/prophets-in-the-quran): How many prophets are in the Quran? See the full list of all 25 prophets named in the Quran, their Bible names, key verses, their stories and their duas.
- [Quran vs Bible - Key Differences and Similarities Explained](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/quran-vs-bible): Quran vs Bible compared clearly. See how the two scriptures differ in structure, language, length and authorship, and what they share, including the Torah.
- [Rabbana Duas: Every Dua in the Quran With Translation](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/rabbana-duas-from-the-quran): The 40 Rabbana duas are Quran prayers that begin "Our Lord." See the full list with verse links and translations, grouped by theme, plus every prophet's dua.
- [Sabr Meaning: Patience in Islam, Its Types and Quran Verses](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/sabr-patience-in-islam): Sabr means patience in Islam: steady restraint in obeying God, avoiding sin and facing trials. Learn the types of sabr, Quran verses on patience and the hadith.
- [Shahada Meaning: The Islamic Declaration of Faith Explained](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/shahada-meaning): The shahada is the Islamic declaration of faith: "There is no god but Allah, and Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah." Its Arabic, meaning and conditions.
- [Signs of the Day of Judgement in Islam: Major and Minor Signs](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/signs-of-the-day-of-judgement): Islamic signs of the Day of Judgement: minor signs, many already seen, and the 10 major signs in Sahih Muslim 2901, including the Dajjal and Jesus' return.
- [SubhanAllah Meaning: What It Means and When Muslims Say It](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/subhanallah-meaning): SubhanAllah means "glory be to God," declaring God free of all imperfection. Learn its Arabic, Quran verses, tasbih after prayer and SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi.
- [Sunni vs Shia: The Real Differences Explained](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/sunni-vs-shia): Sunni vs Shia: the split began over who should lead after the Prophet. Compare beliefs, prayer and hadith, with Pew population data and majority countries.
- [Surah Al Fatihah Meaning, Translation and Transliteration](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/surah-al-fatihah-meaning): Surah al-Fatihah is the opening chapter of the Quran, recited in every prayer. Read its English translation, transliteration and verse-by-verse meaning.
- [Benefits of Surah Kahf, Friday Reading and Its Four Stories](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/surah-al-kahf-benefits): Learn the benefits of Surah Kahf, why Muslims read it every Friday, how its first 10 verses protect from the Dajjal, and the lessons of its four stories.
- [Surah Mulk Meaning, Benefits and Protection in the Grave](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/surah-al-mulk): Surah Mulk is the 67th surah of the Quran. Learn its meaning in English, the benefits of reciting it before sleeping, and its protection in the grave.
- [Surah Waqiah Benefits, Meaning and What the Hadith Really Say](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/surah-al-waqiah): Surah Waqiah benefits explained honestly. Learn what Surah al-Waqi'ah means, the three groups on Judgment Day, and why the famous poverty hadith is graded weak.
- [Surah Rahman Meaning, Translation, Benefits and Key Verses](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/surah-ar-rahman): Surah Rahman explained in plain English. The meaning of "which of the favours of your Lord would you deny," its key themes, and which benefits are authentic.
- [Surah Yasin Meaning in English and Its Authentic Benefits](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/surah-yasin): Surah Yasin is the 36th surah of the Quran. Learn its meaning in English, its main themes, and which popular benefits, like heart of the Quran, are authentic.
- [Tahajjud Prayer: How to Pray It, Best Time, Dua and Benefits](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/tahajjud-prayer): Tahajjud is the voluntary night prayer, best prayed in the last third of the night. Learn how to pray tahajjud, its time, how many rakat, its dua and virtues.
- [Tawakkul Meaning: What It Means to Trust God in Islam](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/tawakkul-trust-in-god): Tawakkul means trusting God in Islam: doing everything you can, then relying on Him for the outcome. Learn the tie your camel hadith, 65:3 and hasbunallah.
- [What Are Jinn? Jinn in Islam and the Quran Explained](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/what-are-jinn): What are jinn? In Islam, jinn are unseen beings created from smokeless fire, with free will like humans. See what the Quran says and how to seek protection.
- [What Do Muslims Believe? The Six Articles of Faith in Islam](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/what-do-muslims-believe): What do Muslims believe? The six articles of faith: God, angels, revealed books, prophets, the Day of Judgement and divine decree, from the hadith of Jibril.
- [What Does Jihad Really Mean? Struggle, War and the Rules of Islam](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/what-does-jihad-mean): What does jihad mean? Jihad means "striving" for God: against one's own ego, by speech and, in limited cases, in defensive war under strict Islamic rules.
- [What Happens When You Die? The Islamic View of the Afterlife](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/what-happens-when-you-die-in-islam): What happens when you die in Islam? The soul is taken by angels, waits in the barzakh, is questioned in the grave, then is resurrected and judged by God.
- [What Is Dhikr? Meaning, Best Dhikr, Adhkar and Benefits](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/what-is-dhikr): Dhikr is the remembrance of God through short phrases and prayers. Learn the dhikr meaning, the best dhikr, morning and evening adhkar, tasbih and its benefits.
- [What Is Hadith? How Muslims Preserved the Prophet's Teachings](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/what-is-hadith): A hadith is a report of what the Prophet Muhammad said, did or approved. Learn how isnad, hadith grading and the six books preserved his teachings.
- [What Is Islam? Basic Beliefs, Practices and Meaning Explained](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/what-is-islam): What is Islam? A clear, simple guide to the religion of Islam, what the word means, its six articles of faith, its five pillars and what Muslims believe.
- [What Is Sharia Law? A Clear Explanation Beyond the Headlines](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/what-is-sharia-law): What is sharia law? Sharia means "the path" and covers prayer, ethics, family and contracts. Learn its sources, aims, punishments, and what Muslims mean by it.
- [What Is Tafsir? Meaning of Quran Tafsir and the Major Works](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/what-is-tafsir): What is tafsir? Learn the tafsir meaning, how it differs from translation, and the major works such as Tafsir Ibn Kathir, at-Tabari and Tafsir al-Jalalayn.
- [What Is Tawheed? The Oneness of God in Islam Explained](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/what-is-tawheed): Tawheed is the Islamic belief in the absolute oneness of God. Learn the tawhid meaning, the three types of tawheed, what shirk is, and its Quranic evidence.
- [What Is the Kaaba? History, Meaning and Why Muslims Face It](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/what-is-the-kaaba): What is the Kaaba? It is the cube-shaped House of God in Makkah, built by Abraham and Ishmael, which Muslims face in prayer and circle during Hajj.
- [What Is the Quran? Meaning, Message and Why It Matters](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/what-is-the-quran): What is the Quran? A clear guide to the holy book of Islam, what the word Quran means, what it is about, what language it is in and why Muslims revere it.
- [What Is Zakat? How It Works, Nisab and Who Must Pay](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/what-is-zakat): Zakat is the obligatory charity in Islam: 2.5% of savings held for a lunar year above the nisab. Learn who pays, who receives it and how to calculate it.
- [Who Created God? A Clear Answer from Islam and Philosophy](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/who-created-god): Who created God? No one. A chain of causes cannot run back forever, so it must begin with an uncreated First Cause. The Islamic and philosophical answer.
- [Who Is Allah? The Meaning of Allah and the God of Islam](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/who-is-allah): Who is Allah? Allah is the Arabic word for the one God, the Creator worshipped by Muslims and named by Arab Christians and Jews. Meaning, origin and attributes.
- [Who Wrote the Quran? Revelation, Scribes and Compilation](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/who-wrote-the-quran): Who wrote the Quran and when was it written? Learn the Muslim belief in revelation, the scribes who wrote it down and how Abu Bakr and Uthman compiled it.
- [Why Do Muslim Women Wear the Hijab? Meaning, Verses and Choice](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/why-do-muslim-women-wear-hijab): Why do Muslim women wear the hijab? Most do it as worship and modesty based on Quran 24:31 and 33:59. Learn its meaning, the types of covering and the debates.
- [Why Do Muslims Fast During Ramadan? Meaning, Rules and Eid](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/why-do-muslims-fast-during-ramadan): Why do Muslims fast during Ramadan? Because the Quran commands it (2:183) so believers grow in God-consciousness. Learn the rules, duas, dates and Eid.
- [Why Does God Allow Suffering? Islam and the Problem of Evil](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/why-does-god-allow-suffering): Why does God allow suffering? Islam teaches that life is a test, justice is completed in the hereafter, and hardship holds hidden wisdom. An honest answer.
- [Why Don't Muslims Eat Pork? The Quranic Reason Explained](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/why-dont-muslims-eat-pork): Why do Muslims not eat pork? Because the Quran forbids it in four verses, including 2:173. Learn the reasons, the link to Jewish law, halal and exceptions.
- [Why Do Muslims Pray Five Times a Day? Meaning and Origins](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/why-muslims-pray-five-times-a-day): Muslims pray five times a day because God made five daily prayers obligatory on the Night Journey. Their names, times, the qibla and their purpose.
- [What Does the Quran Say About Women? Rights, Roles and Dignity](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/women-in-the-quran): What does the Quran say about women? A clear guide to spiritual equality, women's rights, marriage, hijab and the verses scholars discuss most, with quotes.
- [Women's Rights in Islam: What the Quran Grants Women](https://quranuniverse.app/learn/womens-rights-in-islam): Women's rights in Islam include spiritual equality, property, inheritance, marriage consent and divorce. What the Quran grants, and where practice falls short.
